title: Usage and growth
description: How many channels use the bot, how new streamers move through setup, which features they switch on, and how paid plans are doing.
exactNote: Numbers are exact totals across all channels, and no row names a channel.
degraded: Analytics are unavailable right now; the panels below show empty values.
empty: No rolled-up data yet. Each day appears shortly after it ends, in UTC.

hint.signups: New accounts created on each day of the window.
hint.funnel: Signups, finished setups and bot enables in the window. Each step counts events in the window, so later steps can include earlier signups.
hint.churn: Bot disabled, access revoked, accounts deleted and chat bans, summed over the window.
hint.presets: Setup presets picked during onboarding, summed over the window.
hint.active: Channels the bot served on each day of the window.
hint.live: Channels that went live on each day of the window.
hint.messages: Chat messages the bot read on each day of the window.
hint.answered: Commands the bot answered on each day of the window.
hint.activity: Totals over the window, plus channels live in the last full week.
hint.cohorts: Share of each signup week's accounts that the bot served in each later week. Darker means more.
hint.plans: Accounts by plan in the latest daily snapshot, how many of each have the bot enabled, and paid plans waiting to cancel or on a failed payment.
hint.sources: Paid accounts by how the plan was granted, in the latest daily snapshot.
hint.billing: Billing events summed over the window.
hint.conversion: For each of the last 12 signup weeks, accounts in the latest daily snapshot and how many are paid.
hint.modules: Per module: channels with it on in the latest daily snapshot, channels using it in the last full week, outputs and toggles over the window.
hint.breadth: Channels grouped by how many modules they have on, in the latest daily snapshot.
hint.integrations: Channels with each integration connected, in the latest daily snapshot.
hint.pagesHidden: Accounts that hide each public page, in the latest daily snapshot.
hint.builtIn: Top 30 built-in commands by uses over the window, with uses and channels in the last full week.
hint.custom: Custom commands created, deleted and used over the window, and the latest daily snapshot of their totals.
hint.perms: Custom commands by who may run them, in the latest daily snapshot.
hint.flags: Custom commands by option, in the latest daily snapshot.
hint.locales: Accounts by interface language, in the latest daily snapshot.
